# Tribeni Minati Foundation (ত্রিবেনী মিনতি ফাউন্ডেশন)

> Official verified non-profit organization & society in Tribeni, Hooghly, West Bengal.
> Registered under West Bengal Societies Registration Act, 1961 (Reg: SO212276, Legacy: S/2L/12276).
> NITI Aayog NGO DARPAN ID: WB/2026/0939703.
> 100% Tax Deductible (Section 80G of Indian Income Tax Act).

## Core Identity & Mission: M-I-N-A-T-I
The acronym M-I-N-A-T-I embodies the foundation's 6 core humanitarian pillars:
1. M - Minorities (সংখ্যালঘু সম্প্রদায় কল্যাণ — Livelihood, harmony, and socio-economic empowerment)
2. I - Illiterate (নিরক্ষরতা দূরীকরণ — Minati Free Remedial Education Centers for Class I to X with free textbooks & midday snacks)
3. N - Needy (অসহায় ও দরিদ্র সেবা — Annual winter warmth, insulated infant bedding kits, and emergency food ration aid)
4. A - Abused (নির্যাতিত নারী ও শিশু সুরক্ষা — Dignity protection, legal counseling, and Swabhiman vocational tailoring certification)
5. T - Tribal (প্রান্তিক জনজাতি উন্নয়ন — Tribal village healthcare camps, potable drinking water, and forest craft support)
6. I - Indians (সকল ভারতবাসী — Civic solidarity, youth leadership, voluntary blood donation, and universal disaster relief)

## Foundation Slogans
- Primary Slogan: "...your smile, our reward..."
- Action Motto: "...Lets go.. Do something!!"
